p: death of Moses the servant of: The beginning of this book depends on the last chapter of Deuteronomy which was written by Joshua as a preparation to his history.
wilderness and this Lebanon even unto: Of Zin, called Kadesh and Paran.
Hittites: Meaning, the whole land of Canaan.
sea toward the going down of: Called Mediterranean.
prosper whithersoever thou goest: He shows where true prosperity consists, even to obey the word of God.
night: Showing that it is not possible to govern well, without the continual study of God's word.
within three days ye shall pass: Meaning, from the day that this was proclaimed, Jos 3:2.
land: Which belonged to Sihon the king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan.
gave you on this side Jordan: By your request, but yet by God's secret appointment, De 33:21.
so will we hearken unto thee: They not only promise to obey him as long as God is with him: but to help punish all who rebel against him.
